name.value: On Lok Restaurant & Wun Tun House

description.value: On Lok has been a family-owned East Vancouver institution since 1982, built around authentic Chinese comfort food like duck wonton noodle soup, chow mein, and congee served in generous portions. Located on East Hastings in the Hastings-Sunrise neighbourhood, it has a decades-long loyal following among locals who prize its consistently good food and relaxed atmosphere. A touring cyclist passing through East Vancouver will find it a filling and unpretentious stop, with online ordering available through Square.
